title: Closed Request-Validation Error (loc/type list)
description: Closed body for a request that failed model validation: `details` is a list of `{loc, type}` entries. `loc` names only fields of the server's own request model (a client-chosen key is replaced by the fixed label "[unknown]"), and `type` is a validation rule code. No submitted value or client key is ever echoed. This is a different shape from validation_error_schema.json, whose `details` is a `{field: [reason]}` map. The guidance session routes carry `error_code` "VALIDATION_ERROR"; the cold-start route omits `error_code` and also carries a fixed-text `msg` per entry.

error_code.description: Stable code. Present on the guidance session routes; absent on the cold-start route.

loc.description: Path to the offending field of the server's request model.

type.description: Validation rule code, for example "missing" or "extra_forbidden".

msg.description: Fixed server-authored sentence for the rule (cold-start route only); never quotes the request.
